crossRefs.note: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.
For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
The burden of Egypt. “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his…
Let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him. Then let seven times pass over him.
This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men, and ate grass as oxen, and his body was wet…
“Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.
They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

translations.web: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
translations.bsb: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
translations.kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
translations.asv: He taketh away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
